import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { FlightSearchService, FlightInfo } from '../../services/search.service'; import { Route } from '@angular/router'; import { Flights } from 'src/app/services/flights.service'; import { Tickets } from 'src/app/services/tickets.service'; import { Routes } from 'src/app/services/routes.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-search', templateUrl: './search.component.html', styleUrls: ['./search.component.css'] }) export class FlightSearchComponent { depart: string = ''; destination: string = ''; flights : Flights[] = []; routes : Routes[] = []; tickets : Tickets[] = []; loading = false; errorMessage = ''; results : FlightInfo[] = []; /*directFlights: Flight[] = []; layoverConnections: LayoverConnection[] = [];*/ constructor(private flightSearchService: FlightSearchService) {} search(/*depart: string, destination: string*/) { this.errorMessage = ''; this.loading = true; /*this.directFlights = []; this.layoverConnections = [];*/ this.flightSearchService.searchFlights(this.depart, this.destination).subscribe({ next: () => { this.results = this.flights.map(flight => { const route = this.routes.find(r => r._id === flight.route); const tickets = this.tickets.find(t => t.flight === flight._flightcode); return { _id : flight._flightcode, duration : flight.duration, departure : route?.departure?? 'N/A', destination : route?.destination?? 'N/A', price : tickets?.price?? 0 }; }); this.loading = false; /*if (data.length === 0) { this.errorMessage = 'Nessun volo trovato.'; return; } // Capire se sono voli diretti (Flight[]) o con scalo (LayoverConnection[]) if ('firstLeg' in data[0]) { // sono connessioni con scalo this.layoverConnections = data as LayoverConnection[]; } else { // voli diretti this.directFlights = data as Flight[]; }*/ }, error: (err) => { this.loading = false; this.errorMessage = err.error?.errormessage || 'Errore durante la ricerca voli.'; } }); } }
